The metrics period is named 2025-Q1-delivered but ends on 2025-03-30, as audit_spec.yaml sets it, not on the calendar quarter end; the raw export has no row dated 2025-03-31, so no figure changes, but a reader of the label may assume the full quarter.
summary: All five claims recompute exactly from raw_data/orders.csv (net 35741.52; refund rate 27/57 = 0.473684 on paying customers; PL 11181.67, DE 11032.61, CZ 13527.24), populations, periods and caveats are correct, and the machine recalc is rooted only in raw. The stage fails on answer coverage: analysis/answers/R01.json and R02.json restate their questions narrower than raw_data/questions.md asks, so each answer record is bound to a question that was not the one asked, and R02 drops the refund-rate basis part entirely.
